name: Rock Gnome
description: As a rock gnome, you have a natural inventiveness and hardiness beyond that of other gnomes. Most gnomes in the worlds of D&D are rock gnomes, including the tinker gnomes of the Dragonlance setting.

features.name: Age
features.description: Gnomes mature at the same rate as humans, and most are expected to settle into adult life around the age of 40. They can live to 350 years on average, but it's not too uncommon for them to reach 500 years of age.
features.snippet: Gnomes settle into adult life around 40 and can live to 350–500 years.

features.name: Size
features.description: Gnomes are between 3 and 4 feet tall and weigh around 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.
features.snippet: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
features.snippet: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if bright light, and in darkness as if dim light.

features.name: Gnome Cunning
features.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves against magic.
features.snippet: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves against magic.

features.name: Tinker
features.description:
You have proficiency with artisan tools (tinker's tools). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour constructing a Tiny device. The device only functions for 1 hour before needing to be rewound for 1 minute. You can have up to three such devices active at a time. When you create a device, choose one of the following options:
- **Clockwork Toy.** This toy is a clockwork animal, monster, or person, such as a frog, mouse, bird, dragon, or soldier. When placed on the ground, the toy moves 5 feet across the ground on each of your turns in a random direction. It makes noises as appropriate to the creature it represents.
- **Fire Starter.** The device produces a miniature flame, which you can use to light a candle, torch, or campfire. Using the device requires your action.
- **Music Box.** When opened, this music box plays a single song at a moderate volume. The box stops playing when it reaches the song's end or when it is closed.
- **Reproduce Magic.** The device replicates the effect of a cantrip you know. When the cantrip ends, the device must be rewound for 1 minute.
features.snippet: You have proficiency with tinker's tools. You can spend 1 hour to construct a Tiny device (Clockwork Toy, Fire Starter, Music Box, or Reproduce Magic); up to three active at a time.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can read, speak, and write Common and Gnomish.
features.snippet: You can read, speak, and write Common and Gnomish.
